{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-PRIORITIZE",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The pattern P-LIT-PRIORITIZE suggests prioritizing tests to provide earlier failure feedback. In this specific workflow, there is only a single job ('codespell') which executes a single tool. Since there are no multiple test suites or individual test cases to reorder within this workflow, the mechanism of 'test prioritization' cannot be applied to the existing structure without adding new, distinct test jobs. However, to adhere to the instruction of implementing the pattern even if the benefit is uncertain or zero, and given the constraint to keep changes minimal and concrete, I am unable to reorder non-existent tests. Since the pattern requires 'Ranking tests' and this workflow has only one, I will return the original workflow as no valid reordering can be performed on a single-item set.",
  "workflow_yaml": "# Codespell configuration is within pyproject.toml
---
name: Codespell

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  codespell:
    name: Check for spelling errors
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Annotate locations with typos
        uses: codespell-project/codespell-problem-matcher@9ba2c57125d4908eade4308f32c4ff814c184633
      - name: Codespell
        uses: codespell-project/actions-codespell@8f01853be192eb0f849a5c7d721450e7a467c579
"
}
